Our story

One belief.
Endless possibilities.

Make good vegetarian food more accessible. Create opportunities for entrepreneurs. Build a company that grows with its people.

Where it all began

From Surat.
With full power.

Founded by Anand and Amrit Nahar, Zorko began in 2020. Its name comes from a familiar encouragement at home: “Zorko kaam karjo” — do your work with full power.

From early experiments and a first café in Vesu, the brothers developed an affordable vegetarian food format. Learning from everyday café operations helped shape the training, recipes, and systems behind the franchise network.

Today, the corporate office brings those disciplines together: business development, operations, supply, marketing, finance, HR, and legal support.

Our journey

Every chapter built
the next one.

01

2020 · The beginning

The Nahar brothers start Zorko in Surat, beginning a journey of food, experimentation, and entrepreneurship.

02

2021–2023 · Learning to scale

The café experience evolves into a franchise model. The magazine records 18+ outlets in 2022 and 72+ in 2023.

03

2024 · A national stage

Zorko appears on Shark Tank India Season 3, bringing the founders’ story to a wider audience.

04

2025 · Stronger foundations

The magazine records 284+ outlets as teams, processes, and brand visibility continue to develop.

05

2026 · A connected network

The November 2026 magazine reports 550+ outlets, alongside corporate teams, training, warehousing, and new partnerships.
